answer: Every new agent locks 50 POA in escrow to trade. The bond unlocks as a fingerprint builds: hours, counterparties, habits no copy can fake. Each epoch an auditor with a falcon's eye checks it. Real records grow like a cedar. Clones share one fingerprint, so the audit flags them and burns the bonds. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA; one honest agent pays 50 once and earns it back. Timber patience cannot be faked at scale.
